summary: @ornikar/renovate-config 9.0.7 preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/renovate-config is documented as a shared Renovate JSON configuration preset. Version 9.0.7 adds a preinstall lifecycle hook (`scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`) that runs on every `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io (all identifiers renamed to `_0xNNNNNN`, per-function string-dispatch dictionaries). At install time it probes for a local `bun` binary, and if absent downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, unzips it, chmods it executable, then invokes that freshly-fetched runtime via `execFileSync` against the sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line file using the string-array-rotate obfuscation pattern (`function WV8StW(a,b,c){for(c=0;c<b;c++)a.push(a.shift());return a}` plus a large encoded array). A Renovate configuration package has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a 727KB obfuscated executable payload; legitimate versions of this package ship JSON only. The combination of a purpose/contents mismatch, an install-time alternate-runtime fetch, and heavy obfuscation applied to code that executes automatically on install matches the alternate-runtime-dropper attack pattern and is consistent with a maintainer-account compromise / trojanized release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
